components.gap: The success-condition elements (input ranges plus an omitted-variable failure) are given only for an estimate drawn from outside the required source extent, and the failure condition 'report unearned digits' holds in the unit's finite estimates. (1) The one estimate with input ranges and an omitted-variable failure is the 073 lane capacity (073 lines 284-375), built on source Section 1.2 pp. 6-7 (073 lines 28-41 and 447-449 say so), outside the required extent 'chapter 1 sections 1.3-1.5 only for the finite estimate example'. The in-extent finite estimates in the destination body (dimensional lines 566-608: Sec. 1.3 bill-volume and train trees, Sec. 1.4 oil imports) carry no omitted-variable failure, and only the train tree is given input ranges (3200-10800 per hour, not reported as an order of magnitude). (2) Unearned digits are reported: the Sec. 1.4 oil estimate is given as 'about 3.33 10^9 barrels per year' from one-significant-figure leaf values and set against a reported 3.34 billion (dimensional lines 599-603; the held source reports 3 x 10^9, printed pp. 15-16), and the flight-range order estimate, which the text says 'discards a factor of order two', is given as 'about 9.8 10^6 m' (dimensional lines 427-433; held source eq. (4.86), printed p. 133: about 10^7 m).
